correctness.rationale: Complete nonplane full-binary root-split recurrence generates exactly 1,1,2,3,6,11,23,46 shapes at two through nine leaves, matching OEIS A001190. Equality of mean curves is equivalent to equality of clade-size counts by polynomial coefficient comparison. Exhaustive 46-shape exact check finds precisely one two-member class; both nine-leaf trees share size spectrum (nine 1, three 2, one 3, two 4, one 5). Nested-edge covariance counts differ only by a (5,2) versus (5,3) pair, proving Var(B)-Var(A)=2p(1-p)^7 for all p in (0,1). Independent 512-subset exact rational calculation at p=1/2 reproduces means 335/32 and variances 6483/1024 and 6491/1024. Code path check_pd_fingerprints.py was executed and produced VERIFY_OK.

originality.rationale: The exact question is the first noninjectivity of the complete independent-extinction mean-PD curve on unlabeled unit-edge full-binary shapes and restoration of injectivity by variance at nine leaves. Inspected primary papers establish indicator calculations, PD variance under different sampling regimes, and nonidentification by matrix spectra, but no inspected result implies the enumerated nine-leaf threshold, unique collision, and exact variance separation. Earlier methods can compute individual cases; they do not alone state the classification. Historical priority is explicitly provisional because Faller–Pardi–Steel full text was unavailable.
residual_risks: Faller–Pardi–Steel 2007 preprint / 2008 journal full text remained inaccessible despite arXiv/OA and institution-access attempts; hidden nine-leaf shape examples cannot be excluded.
A highly specialized unindexed tree-shape profile catalogue might contain the same first-collision census, despite the listed alias and table searches.
No independent historical-priority audit has been performed.

value.rationale: The complete independent-extinction expected rooted-PD response curve is a natural conservation-risk observable encoding a tree shape only through its clade-size multiset. The sharp first ambiguity at nine taxa and its universal variance resolution identify the exact limit of mean-only structural discrimination within a standard equal-branch idealization. This is a motivated minimal finite identifiability boundary with a complete classification, not an arbitrary numerical point or straightforward restatement of the generic moment formula.
